units.source_text: 暂且想通了，闲话休提，先来抽口烟吧。

en.t: For the moment he had made sense of it; enough idle talk, first he would have a smoke.
It had been a week, and it was truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 他用习惯了的动作，在烟盒的商标贴纸旁开了个四角的口子，撕开包装。

en.t: With a practiced motion, he made a square opening beside the brand label on the cigarette pack and tore open the wrapping.
The cellophane felt slick and slippery to the touch.

units.source_text: 他用手指弹了弹烟盒底部，把香烟叩出来。

en.t: He flicked the bottom of the pack with his finger and knocked a cigarette out.

units.source_text: 捏香烟的手指轻轻颤抖着。

en.t: The fingers holding the cigarette were trembling slightly.

units.source_text: 他就着灯上的火点着了烟。

en.t: He lit the cigarette from the flame of the lamp.

units.source_text: 深深地，悠悠地，胸膛里满满地吸进了一口落叶之香，渗透到血管的各个角落。

en.t: Deeply and slowly, he drew a full breath of the scent of fallen leaves into his chest, and it seeped into every corner of his veins.

units.source_text: 嘴唇麻木，眼睑的内侧沉甸甸地垂下了天鹅绒的幕布。

en.t: His lips went numb, and inside his eyelids a heavy velvet curtain seemed to fall.

units.source_text: 紧绷绷的晕眩，令他毛骨悚然。

en.t: The taut dizziness made his flesh crawl.
